dTip.age: Shawara: Tsofanci ba za a guje ba. Raba kafin ka mutu.
dTip.eaten: Shawara: Ka guje wa mafarauta, yi amfani da Lokacin Alheri don gudu.
dTip.lysis: Shawara: Kwayoyin cuta ne ke haifar da fashewa. Ka nisanta su.
dTip.starve: Shawara: Ka ci akai-akai, ka zauna kusa da tarin abinci, ko ka canza saurin ka.
dTip.temp: Shawara: Ka duba ma'aunin zafi. Ka canza yanayin zafin ka.

dna.ok: An shigo da DNA cikin nasara!
edu.hoverHint: Dora wata ma'ana a cikin kwaya — sunan sashi da aikinsa
edu.chloro.desc: Sinadarin haske: haske + CO₂ + H₂O → sukari + O₂. Kore daga chlorophyll. Ana samunsa a tsire-tsire na ruwa da na ƙasa.
edu.chloro.name: Chloroplast
edu.cilia.desc: Gajerun gashin motsi. Suna haifar da kwararar ruwa: motsi + cin abinci ta tacewa (jan ƙwayoyin cuta da tsire zuwa baki).
edu.cilia.name: Gashin motsi
edu.cyto.desc: Cikin kwaya: ruwa, sunadaran, organelles. Dubban sinadarai ke faruwa a nan.
edu.cyto.name: Ruwan cikin kwaya
edu.flagella.desc: Injin iyo mai tsayi. Yana juyawa ko lanƙwasa — kwayar tana iyo zuwa abinci ko nesa da haɗari (chemotaxis).
edu.flagella.name: Bulala
edu.membrane.desc: Kwance-kwancen lipida mai kyau. Yana sarrafa abin da ke shiga da fita. Kowace kwaya na da shi.
edu.membrane.name: Fatar kwaya
edu.mito.desc: Gidan wuta na kwaya. Numfashi: sukari + O₂ → ATP (kuzari). Yana da DNA nasa — ragowar tsohon ƙwayar cuta.
edu.mito.name: Mitokondiriya
edu.nucleoid.desc: Wuri mai DNA zagaye a prokaryotes. Babu rufin tsakiya — genome yana yawo cikin ruwan kwaya.
edu.nucleoid.name: Yankin DNA
edu.nucleus.desc: Yana adana DNA. Yana sarrafa girma, rarrabewa da samar da sunadaran. Ƙwayoyin cuta babu gaskiyar tsakiya — DNA tana cikin yankin DNA.
edu.nucleus.name: Kwayar tsakiya
edu.oral.desc: A cikin masu gashin motsi — rami inda gashi ke kora ganima. Abinci yana shiga kwantenonin narkewa daga nan.
edu.oral.name: Ramin baki
edu.vacuole.desc: Kwanto da ruwa, ajiya ko sinadaran narkewa. Masu gashi na da kwantenonin narkewa da fitar ruwa.
edu.vacuole.name: Vacuole
edu.wall.desc: Tsarin tauri a wajen fatar kwaya (peptidoglycan a ƙwayoyin cuta, cellulose a tsire-tsire). Kariya da siffa.
edu.wall.name: Bangon kwaya
help.body:
Sarrafawa: WASD iyo. Space = ciza. LMB = iyo zuwa alamar.

Wane ya ci wane:

🌱 Shuke-shuke suna cin haske. 🔵 Ƙananan masu ci suna cin shuke-shuke. 🟠 Matsakaitan masu ci suna tace ƙwayoyin cuta+shuke-shuke. 🟣 Manyan mafarauta suna cin shuke-shuke, ƙwayoyin cuta da masu cin tsakiya — kuma suna iya ciza manyan ganima kaɗan.

Kyamara: F kyamara kyauta, V komawa kwaya. Keke = zumwa.

Rarrabewa: Ci, girma, raba. Q = da hannu.
lb.title: 🏆 Matsayi
mapTip: Ƙaramar taswira: inda kake a cikin tafki. Danna yana motsa kyamara.
menuSub: Kwaikwayon ƙananan halittu — nau'i {n} + ƙwayoyin cuta. Ana kallon tafki daga gefe.
midEaterTip: Matsakakin mai ci: iyo zuwa shuke-shuke ko bakteriya. Gashin motsi na tacewa su kaɗai.
noSpecies: Babu nau'i a cikin "{cat}". Danna Duka.
popTip: Jadawalin yawa: nawa halittu a tsawon lokaci.
role.consumer1: Ƙananan masu ci (bakteriya). Suna cin shuke-shuke. Abincin masu cin tsakiya da manya.
role.consumer2: Matsakaitan masu ci (masu gashin motsi). Suna tace ruwa: jan bakteriya da shuke-shuke. Kada su ka yaƙi manya.
role.consumer3: Manyan mafarauta. Suna cin shuke-shuke, bakteriya da masu cin tsakiya. Suna iya ciza manyan ganima kaɗan — haɗari ne. Suna rayuwa tsawo ba tare da abinci, amma yunwa na kashe.
role.decomposer: Masu tsaftacewa. Suna warware gawa — ba sa farautar rayayyu.
role.macrophage: Masu gadi. Suna kai wa cuta masu haɗari hari — tsarin rigakafi na tafki.
role.producer: Shuke-shuke. Babu farauta. Suna cin haske da ruwa — ƙananan tsire-tsire. Suna ciyar da sauran duka.
roleHint: Alaƙa: ana nuna abinci da zobe mai launi. Layin kamansin abinci yana sama dama.
tip.ageBar: Shekaru na halitta. Tsoffin kwayoyi suna rasa kuzari sauri.
tip.cbFilter: Tacewar halitta. Danna don nuna wannan nau'i kaɗai a cikin meni.
tip.daysL: Kwanakin wasa. Canjin yanayi yana shafar zafi.
tip.energyBar: Kuzarin halitta. Tana raguwa da lokaci. Idan ta yi sifiri — mutuwar yunwa.
tip.fly: Tashi kyauta: F ko WASD / maus
tip.fpsL: Firam a daƙiƙa (FPS). Yana nuna aikin wasa.
tip.lightL: Matakin haske. Muhimmanci ga sinadarin haske na shuke-shuke.
tip.popC: Jadawalin yawa. Yana nuna tarihin haihuwa da mutuwa.
tip.tempL: Zafin ruwa. Yana shafar sinadarin jiki da rayuwa.

tut.s1.body: Kai ƙaramin halitta ne a cikin tafki. Manufa: ci, girma, raba. Danna Na gaba.
tut.s1.title: Barka da zuwa
tut.s2.body: WASD don iyo. Maus yana nuna hanya. Motsa, sa'an nan danna Na gaba.
tut.s2.title: Motsi
tut.s3.body: Iyo zuwa ƙaramar kwaya ka danna CI (E). Za ka ga haske.
tut.s3.title: Cin abinci
tut.s4.body: Lokacin da kuzari ta cika, ka danna RABA (Q). Kwayar ta ragu. Haka ake.
tut.s4.title: Rarrabewa
tut.s5.body: Kyamara: biye ko tashi kyauta. Sa'a a juyin halitta!
tut.s5.title: An gama
